::: {.callout-note}
## Developer Reference

This is a UIAO JSON Schema, rendered as a developer-reference page per
[ADR-072](../../adr/adr-072-canon-publication-policy.qmd).

- **Source:** [`src/uiao/schemas/locpath/location-registry.schema.json`](../../../src/uiao/schemas/locpath/location-registry.schema.json)
- **Dialect:** `https://json-schema.org/draft/2020-12/schema`
- **`$id`:** `https://uiao.io/schemas/locpath/location-registry.schema.json`
:::

## Description

Envelope for an executable LocPath location registry (ADR-102 §D6 / UIAO_194). A registry is a versioned, provenance-anchored collection of location nodes; each node is validated individually against location.schema.json at load time by uiao.modernization.locpath (no JSON Schema $ref, so per-node errors stay addressable). The 'reference' registry shipped as executable canon is the UIAO_194 worked example, not deployment data — agency registries are loaded from their own paths with the same contract.

## Top-Level Properties

| Property | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|:---:|---|
| `schema_version` | string | ✓ | Location-registry schema version (independent of the node schema). Major pinned to 1. |
| `document_id` | `const: 'UIAO_194'` | ✓ | Location registries are executable canon under the UIAO_194 allocation, the way codebook.yaml is under UIAO_151 and binding profiles are under UIAO_193. |
| `registry_id` | string | ✓ | Kebab-case stable identifier. 'reference' is the canonical worked example shipped with the substrate; agency registries use their own ids. |
| `display_name` | string | ✓ |  |
| `status` | enum: 'reference', 'proposed', 'active', 'deprecated' | ✓ | reference = the canonical worked example (UIAO_194 §Worked example); proposed = specified, not yet authoritative; active = the governed location registry of record; deprecated = retiring, must name successor. |
| `description` | string |  |  |
| `updated` | string | ✓ | Date of last governed change to this registry. |
| `nodes` | array&lt;object&gt; | ✓ | Location nodes. Each is validated against location.schema.json plus the UIAO_194 integrity rules (level/depth consistency, uniqueness, parent existence) at load time. |

## Full Schema

```{.json filename="location-registry.schema.json"}
{
  "$schema": "https://json-schema.org/draft/2020-12/schema",
  "$id": "https://uiao.io/schemas/locpath/location-registry.schema.json",
  "title": "UIAO LocPath Location Registry",
  "description": "Envelope for an executable LocPath location registry (ADR-102 \u00a7D6 / UIAO_194). A registry is a versioned, provenance-anchored collection of location nodes; each node is validated individually against location.schema.json at load time by uiao.modernization.locpath (no JSON Schema $ref, so per-node errors stay addressable). The 'reference' registry shipped as executable canon is the UIAO_194 worked example, not deployment data \u2014 agency registries are loaded from their own paths with the same contract.",
  "type": "object",
  "additionalProperties": false,
  "required": [
    "schema_version",
    "document_id",
    "registry_id",
    "display_name",
    "status",
    "updated",
    "nodes"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "schema_version": {
      "type": "string",
      "pattern": "^1\\.[0-9]+\\.[0-9]+$",
      "description": "Location-registry schema version (independent of the node schema). Major pinned to 1."
    },
    "document_id": {
      "const": "UIAO_194",
      "description": "Location registries are executable canon under the UIAO_194 allocation, the way codebook.yaml is under UIAO_151 and binding profiles are under UIAO_193."
    },
    "registry_id": {
      "type": "string",
      "pattern": "^[a-z0-9][a-z0-9-]*$",
      "description": "Kebab-case stable identifier. 'reference' is the canonical worked example shipped with the substrate; agency registries use their own ids."
    },
    "display_name": {
      "type": "string"
    },
    "status": {
      "enum": [
        "reference",
        "proposed",
        "active",
        "deprecated"
      ],
      "description": "reference = the canonical worked example (UIAO_194 \u00a7Worked example); proposed = specified, not yet authoritative; active = the governed location registry of record; deprecated = retiring, must name successor."
    },
    "description": {
      "type": "string"
    },
    "updated": {
      "type": "string",
      "format": "date",
      "description": "Date of last governed change to this registry."
    },
    "nodes": {
      "type": "array",
      "minItems": 1,
      "items": {
        "type": "object"
      },
      "description": "Location nodes. Each is validated against location.schema.json plus the UIAO_194 integrity rules (level/depth consistency, uniqueness, parent existence) at load time."
    }
  }
}
```
